Ava (People Ops): Heads up — we're updating the handbook language around flex time & comp-time accrual to align with recent regional guidance. This is mostly clarifying carryover and approval flow, but managers need to acknowledge and teams will need to e-sign. Quick RSVP for a 15-min Q&A here: https://go.company/qna (please react with :eyes: if you want a manager-only session).

Ravi K.: Quick Q — does this change accrual caps or just wording? We have folks across EU and APAC.

Ava (People Ops): Good question. Mostly wording + an explicit regional table. Accrual caps are unchanged for now. We'll add a short FAQ entry for EU/UK rules. Draft here: https://docs.company/handbook/drafts/flex-accrual-v2 (feedback welcome).

Jordan H.: I can run the manager session Thu 3/26 10:00am PT. @Ravi would that time work for your leads?

Ravi K.: Thu 10am PT works for me — can we record for APAC?

Jordan H.: Yep we will record and drop captions.

Priya L.: Does this affect contractor eligibility for comp-time, or only full-time headcount?

Ava (People Ops): Contractors are explicitly excluded from comp-time eligibility — adding that line to the FAQ now. Thanks for flagging, Priya.

Ravi K.: Also, for manager comms can we get a one-paragraph summary I can paste into 1:1s?

Ava (People Ops): Will do — I'll post a manager blurb and an email template after this thread.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: policy change announcement set to go out 24h after finalization. E-sign invite will be auto-sent to employees 1 day after announcement.

Ava (People Ops): Tracking RSVPs below. Managers please confirm your teams have ack'd by EOW. If you need a separate time slot for timezone reasons, say so here. :calendar:

Ravi K.: Confirming — I'll push ack in my next team sync.

Priya L.: Thanks — marked as :eyes:.

Jordan H.: Added recording + caption action items to the session invite.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks all — closing the loop once the draft is final and the e-sign link is live.
